## Technical Corrections to This Historical Draft

This source is retained for audit history and is excluded from the production reading path. The corrections below govern its interpretation; the original wording is preserved separately.

The displayed time-step formula is a Taylor expansion of a sufficiently smooth exact solution, evaluated at the beginning of the step. Forward Euler keeps its first two terms. Under the usual Lipschitz and bounded-derivative assumptions it has local error $O(\Delta t^2)$ and global error $O(\Delta t)$ over a fixed finite interval. A control discontinuity or impact must be handled separately.

Derivatives of one declared discrete map add linearly at a common nominal state and input. This does not make finite control interventions additive. A measured residual may contain linearization, discretization, parameter, observation and model errors; its magnitude does not isolate geometric curvature. See [finite differences and residual bounds](../../../tangent-hyperplanes-series/part-4-residuals-curvature.html).

## Discrete-Time Structure

$$
x_{k+1} = x_k + f(x_k,u_k)\Delta t + O(\Delta t^2)
$$

## Attribution

Local infinitesimal contributions add exactly per step.

## Residuals

Residuals quantify curvature and higher-order coupling.
